name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` support. This balances visibility for users who rely on focus indicators with comfort for those sensitive to motion. The 7:1 contrast meets WCAG AAA for text and interactive elements, ensuring readability for low-vision users. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on reduced-motion systems, but this is negligible compared to the accessibility gain.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 7:1 fails users toggling *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—WCAG 2.2 requires focus rings to persist regardless of reduced motion settings. Alternative: 3px ring at 4.5:1 with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` override to 6px. Settle with user testing measuring task completion time for keyboard-only navigation.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast, with a 6px ring when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active. This meets WCAG 2.2 by ensuring focus rings always appear, even when users toggle reduced motion and high contrast. The trade-off is slightly less bold focus rings for users who prefer no motion, but it guarantees accessibility for everyone. User testing will confirm if the 6px ring is sufficient for reduced-motion users.
[dispatched 3 workers: worker-2692, worker-5666, worker-5684 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: Risk: 3px at 4.5:1 fails users who toggle *high contrast mode*—WCAG 2.2 requires focus rings to persist in *all* contrast modes. Better: 2px ring at 3:1 with `forced-colors: active` override to 4px. Settle with user testing measuring error rates in high-contrast mode.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 2px focus ring at 3:1 contrast with `forced-colors: active` override to 4px; deliver WCAG 2.2-compliant focus visibility in all modes; owner: accessibility-w1.
